snippet.title: Can You Get All 4 Across in 17 Minutes? 🔦 Riddle #1 #shorts
snippet.description:
The torch dies in 17 minutes. Four friends, one bridge that holds two, and they need the torch to cross. Adam takes 1 minute, Zara 2, Omar 5, Grandad 10.

Most people get 19. Can you do it in 17?

Comment your answer. The solution drops tomorrow at sunrise.

#riddle #puzzle #brainteaser
